blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-based model collaboration requires a large model to generate intermediate responses before a smaller model can use its guidance, adding large-model decoding cost to inference. We introduce POND (Prefill-Only, No-Decode), a method that uses a frozen large sender for prefill and a small receiver for all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps the sender's hidden states to additional attention keys and values, allowing the receiver to use these representations throughout generation. POND also supports periodic review, in which the sender processes the receiver's partial response and updates its guidance through additional prefill passes while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, POND improves receiver performance with senders from different model families. In particular, GLM-5.3 provides gains comparable to those of Qwen3.8-Max when paired with a Qwen receiver, supporting the effectiveness of representation transfer between independently trained model families. POND further demonstrates its ability to generalize across domains. When trained on math and coding tasks, it transfers directly to general knowledge tasks without additional domain-specific training. These results demonstrate that large frontier model prefill representations can improve small-model generation without requiring large-model autoregressive decoding.
blocks.zh: 基于文本的模型协作需要大型模型在更小的模型能够使用它的取向之前生成中间响应,为推断增加大型模型的解码成本. 我们引入了 POND(Prefill-Only, No-Decode),这种方法使用被冻结的大型发送器进行预装,并使用小型接收器进行所有自旋解码. 一个可训练的桥图将发送者隐藏的状态映射到额外的注意键和值上,使接收器能够全代使用这些表示. POND还支持定期审核,发送者在审核中处理接收器的部分响应,并通过额外的预填通行证来更新其指导,同时保留接收器现有的KV缓存. 在整个推理和编码基准中,POND与来自不同模范家庭的发送者一起改进了接收者的性能. 特别是,GLM-5.3提供了与Quen3.8-Max在与Quen接收器配对时相类似的收益,支持独立培训的模范家庭之间的代表转移的有效性. POND进一步表明它有能力跨越各个领域。 在接受数学和编码任务培训时,它直接转移到一般知识任务上,而不进行额外的域特有培训. 这些结果表明,大型前沿模型预填表示可以改进小模型生成而不需要大型模型自递解码.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Natural language is the primary means of human communication, and multi-model systems often mimic this approach by exchanging generated text.
One model generates an intermediate response that another model then uses as input ( Du et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) . Text supports communication between models with different architectures,
but requires the sender to generate an intermediate response and then the receiver to process it.
Such communication can be particularly costly when a frontier-scale model assists a smaller model deployed on edge hardware.
In this setting, the large model decodes the intermediate response that will be sent the small model token by token, so the system incurs large-model decoding latency even though the small model produces the final answer.
These limitations motivate a key question:
blocks.zh:
自然语言是人类交流的主要手段,多模型系统往往通过交换生成的文本来模仿这种方法.
一个模型产生中间反应,另一个模型随后用作输入(Du等,2023;Wu等,2023;Wang等,2024a.). 文本支持不同架构的模型之间的通信,
但要求发送者生成中间响应,然后接收器进行处理.
当前沿模型协助部署在边缘硬件上的较小模型时,这种通信费用可能特别高。
在这个设定中,大模型解码会以代号方式发送出小模型令牌的中间响应,因此系统即使小模型产生出最终的答案,也会发生大模型解码时空.
这些限制引发了一个关键问题:

blocks.en: Can a large model improve a small model’s generation without incurring the latency of autoregressive decoding?
blocks.zh: 一个大模型能否改善一个小模型的一代,而不引起自相递减编码的后期性?

blocks.en:
Our approach rests on an asymmetry in large-model inference cost. During prefill, a model processes all input tokens in parallel; the computation is compute-bound and uses the hardware efficiently. Standard autoregressive decoding instead requires one forward pass per generated token.
These passes must run sequentially, so total decoding latency grows with response length, making long responses particularly time-consuming to generate ( Patel et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) .
Prefill produces contextual representations of the input without requiring the large model to generate text. We therefore investigate how much of the benefit of large-model assistance can be recovered by transferring these representations directly to a small model.

这些通行证必须相接而行,因此总的解码间隔随着响应长度的增大而增加,使长时间的响应特别需要时间生成(Patel等,2024;Zhong等,2024.).
预填产生输入的上下文表示而不需要大模型生成文本. 因此,我们调查如何通过将这些陈述直接转移到一个小模型中来恢复大模式援助的好处。

blocks.en: We refer to the large model as the sender and the small model as the receiver . The main challenge is that the two models are trained independently. Their hidden dimensions differ, and even at matched dimensions their representation spaces are not aligned, so the receiver cannot use the sender’s states directly. We address this with a trainable bridge that maps sender hidden states to additional attention keys and values in the receiver. Both models read the same input, and the receiver attends to the bridged keys and values alongside its own context. The bridge is trained with the receiver’s next-token prediction loss on target answers, while the sender remains frozen.
blocks.zh: 我们把大模型称为发送器,小模型称为接收器。 主要挑战在于两种模式都是独立训练的. 它们隐藏的维度不同,即使在相匹配的维度上,它们的表示空间也不对齐,因此接收器不能直接使用发送者的状态. 我们用一个可训练的桥梁来解决这个问题,该桥将发送者隐藏的状态映射到接收器中更多的注意键和值. 两个模型都读取相同的输入,接收器在自己上下文的同时关注被桥接的键和值. 桥被训练为接收器在目标答案上的下接预测损失,而发送者仍然被冻结.

blocks.en: A related approach is multi-token prediction (MTP), which trains additional prediction heads or modules to predict multiple future tokens from a model’s hidden states ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . These modules can also be used for speculative decoding, where the main model verifies proposed tokens. POND instead transfers hidden states between separately pretrained models and trains the bridge using the receiver’s next-token prediction objective. The receiver generates the final response directly, without sender verification or a requirement to preserve the sender’s output distribution. The goal is to improve small-model generation using large-model prefill, rather than to accelerate sampling from the large model.
blocks.zh: 一个相关的方法是多键预测(MTP),它训练额外的预测头或模块,从模型的隐藏状态来预测多个未来符号(Gloeckle等,2024;Liu等,2024). 这些模块也可用于投机解码,其中主要模型验证所推荐的符. POND则将隐藏状态转移到不同预试模型之间, 接收器直接生成最后响应,而无需发送者验证或要求保存发送者输出分布. 目标是利用大模型预填来改进小模型生成,而不是从大模型中加速采样.

blocks.en:
We also extend POND with periodic review . In the initial-only setting, the sender processes the prompt once. With review, the sender periodically processes the available response prefix through an additional prefill pass.
The bridge maps updated sender representations to keys and values, while the receiver continues decoding from its existing KV cache.
Review allows sender guidance to depend on the partial response while keeping all autoregressive decoding in the receiver.

我们还定期对POND进行审查。 在初始的设定中,发送者处理一次快取. 通过审核,发件人会定期通过额外的预补卡处理可用的响应前缀.
桥头图将发送者表达式更新到密钥和值,而接收器则继续从现有的KV缓存中解码.
审查允许发送者指导依赖于部分响应,同时将所有自旋解码保留在接收器中.

blocks.en: We evaluate POND on math, code, and general-knowledge tasks using three frontier-scale senders and an edge-scale receiver. Initial transfer alone improves receiver performance. Periodic review provides further gains, particularly for tasks requiring long-form generation. By updating the sender representations based on the partial response, periodic review maintains effective guidance over extended decoding. These results show that frontier-model prefill representations can effectively guide small-model generation without requiring large-model autoregressive decoding. Periodically updating these representations further improves their effectiveness for long outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们利用三个前沿发送器和一个边缘级接收器,评估POND的数学、密码和一般知识任务。 仅初始转移就改善了接收者的性能. 定期审查提供了进一步的收益,特别是在需要长形式生成的任务方面。 通过根据部分答复更新发送者的陈述,定期审查对扩展的解码保持有效的指导。 这些结果显示,前沿模型预填表示可以有效引导小模型生成而不需要大模型自递解码. 定期更新这些说明进一步提高了长期产出的效力。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: • We propose POND , a collaboration framework in which a frozen large sender performs only prefill and a small receiver performs all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps sender hidden states to additional attention keys and values in the receiver, allowing the two independently trained models to communicate without intermediate text. • We introduce periodic review, which lets the sender re-read the partial response through additional prefill passes.
This allows guidance to adapt to the subsequent response without requiring sender-side decoding or recomputation of the receiver’s generated prefix. • We show that, across frontier-scale senders, POND consistently improves receiver performance on math and code tasks and transfers directly to general knowledge tasks without additional training. These results highlight POND ’s cross-domain generalizability.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Model Communication and Collaboration
blocks.zh: 2.1 交流与合作模式

blocks.en:
Many multi-model systems improve performance by allowing language models to exchange natural-language messages.
Prior work has explored communication both within a single
model ( Qu et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026b ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) and across multiple models. Multi-agent debate, for example,
lets several models propose, critique, and revise their solutions over multiple rounds ( Du et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) .
General agent frameworks organize models into specialized roles and coordinate their work through conversation ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) . Mixture-of-Agents follows a layered design in which each model conditions on the textual outputs produced by models in the previous layer ( Wang et al., 2024a ) . Other work studies how the communication topology can be made sparse to reduce the token and inference cost of multi-agent discussion ( Li et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
许多多模式系统通过允许语言模型交流自然语言信息来提高性能.
以前的工作探讨过在单一的、
型号(Qu等,2024;Sun等,2026b;DeepSeek-AI,2026)并跨多型号. 多代理辩论,例如,
让几个模型在多轮中提出、批评和修改其解决方案(Du等人,2023;Chen等人,2024)。
一般代理框架将模型组织成专门的角色,并通过对话来协调工作(Wu等,2023;Qian等,2024). 代理人混合采用分层设计,每个模型对上层模型产生的文字输出(Wang等,2024a. 其他工作研究如何使交流地貌变得稀疏,以降低多剂讨论的象征和推论成本(Li等,2024.).

blocks.en:
Text offers an interpretable interface across heterogeneous models, but incurs sender-side decoding costs and limits communication to what the sender expresses in text.
Beyond text-based communication, Cache-to-Cache ( Fu et al., 2026 ) enables direct semantic transfer by projecting and fusing KV caches across models.
LLM-to-SLM ( Bergner et al., 2024 ) uses a frozen large language model to encode the prompt once in parallel and conditions a smaller model on the resulting representations to generate the response. POND learns a latent channel that transforms frontier-model hidden states into a separate guidance memory, preserving the receiver’s text KV cache.
This interface supports both initial transfer and response-dependent periodic review, allowing the sender to provide guidance entirely through prefill while the receiver handles all autoregressive decoding.
blocks.zh:
文本提供了一个跨不同模型的可解释界面,但会产生发送方的解码费用,并将通信限制在发送方在文本中表达的内容.
除了基于文本的通信外,Cache-to-Cache(Fu等,2026年)通过跨模型投影和引信KV缓存来进行直接语义转移.
LLM-to-SLM(Bergner等,2024年)使用被冷冻的大型语言模型来将快取编码一次,同时附加条件在所生成的表示上一个较小的模型来生成响应. POND 学习了一种潜在的通道,将前沿模型隐藏状态转换成单独的向导内存,保存接收者的文本 KV 缓存 。
该接口支持初始传输和依赖响应的定期审查,允许发送者完全通过预填来提供指导,而接收者则处理所有自旋解码.

blocks.en: 2.2 Knowledge Distillation and Latent Reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.2 知识沉滞和迟钝

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation trains a smaller student to reproduce information provided by a larger teacher, commonly through output distributions or teacher-generated sequences ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Kim & Rush, 2016 ) . Feature-based methods additionally match hidden states, attention patterns, or other intermediate representations ( Jiao et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) . For generative language models, recent methods distill teacher distributions, supervise the student on its own generated sequences, or use teacher-generated rationales as additional training targets ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Hsieh et al., 2023 ) .
These methods typically transfer teacher knowledge into a standalone student that operates without the teacher at inference time.

这些方法通常会将教师的知识转移到一个独立的学生身上,在推论时间没有教师的情况下运作.

A related line of work explores intermediate computation beyond the final visible output.

These methods primarily study reasoning within a single model, whereas POND transfers prefill representations between independently trained models without sender-side autoregressive decoding.

blocks.en: We evaluate POND in two settings: a single prefill-only transfer, where the sender reads the input once, and periodic review, where the sender additionally reads the receiver’s partial response at selected boundaries.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
Qwen3.5-4B ( Team, 2026 ) is the receiver in all conditions. The senders are Qwen3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , GLM-5.3 ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026 ) , and DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , providing one within-family and two cross-family pairings.
The sender remains frozen, while the receiver and bridge are jointly optimized using the conditional likelihood in Equation 1 . Receiver alone generates from the original prompt without the bridge. POND supplies latent KV entries from one sender prefill pass and makes no further sender calls. +Review additionally processes the available response prefix and appends latent updates as described in Section 3.5 .
In both bridged conditions, all output tokens are generated by the receiver.
The receiver-alone comparison measures the combined effect of receiver adaptation, bridge training, and sender guidance, so it does not isolate the contribution of sender information from that of receiver training. The POND –Review comparison measures the additional benefit and cost of periodic sender updates under matched training and evaluation protocols.

blocks.en: 4.4 Accuracy–Latency Trade-offs and Periodic Review
blocks.zh: 4.4 准确性与合理性权衡和定期审查

blocks.en:
Relative to the receiver, +Review reduces average output volume by 15.6–22.4% on math/code and 15.5–22.3% on knowledge tasks (Tables 1 and 2 ).
The corresponding latency reductions are only 4.9–9.6% on math/code and range from a 6.5% reduction to a 0.1% increase on knowledge tasks.
Sender prefill and latent conditioning still incur computation, so fewer receiver tokens do not establish proportional savings in total compute.
blocks.zh:
相对于接收器,+审查将数学/代码的平均产出量减少15.6至22.4%,知识任务的平均产出量减少15.5至22.3%(表1和表2)。
相应的延迟性降低在数学/代码上只有4.9-9.6%,从6.5%的降低到知识任务增长0.1%不等.
发件人预填和潜在条件仍然需要计算,因此较少的接收符不能在总计算中建立比例节约.

blocks.en:
Review improves accuracy and reduces output volume relative to single-transfer POND in all 27 sender–task pairs.
Its incremental macro-average gain is 0.7–0.9 points on math/code and 0.60–0.74 points on knowledge tasks.
However, the additional prefill passes increase latency relative to single transfer in every pair.
Review remains faster than the receiver on the longest-output tasks, including AIME, OlymMath-Hard, LiveCodeBench, and GPQA-Diamond, but exceeds receiver latency for every sender on the shorter HumanEval+, MBPP+, and MMLU-Redux tasks.
This pattern is consistent with review overhead being easier to amortize over longer generations, although component-level timing is needed to establish the mechanism.
blocks.zh:
审查提高准确性,并减少所有27个发送者任务对中单向传输的POND的输出量。
其递增的宏观平均收益为数学/代码0.7–0.9分和知识任务0.60–0.74分.
然而,与每对单次转让相比,额外预补通行证增加了间隔时间。
对最长产出任务,包括AIME,OlymMath-Hard,LiveCode Bench,和GPQA-Diamond的审查仍然快于接收者,但对于在更短的HumanEval+,MBPP+,和MMLU-Redux任务上的每个发送者来说,都超过了接收者的潜伏.
这种模式与审查间接费用比较容易分期摊还,尽管建立这一机制需要部分时间。

blocks.en: The benefit of review is consistent with a trajectory-dependent effect. Its incremental gains are largest on long-output tasks such as AIME, LiveCodeBench, and GPQA-Diamond, where guidance computed from the initial prompt may become less informative as the response develops. On shorter tasks, review provides smaller accuracy gains while adding proportionally greater latency. This pattern suggests that review is most useful when the evolving reasoning trajectory contains information not available in the initial prompt.
blocks.zh: 审查的好处与视轨效应一致。 它在长期产出任务(如AIME、LiveCode Bench和GPQA-Diamond)方面的增量收益最大,随着反应的发展,从最初的速率计算出的指导信息可能变得较少。 就较短的任务而言,审查的准确性提高较小,同时按比例增加较大的延迟。 这种模式表明,当演化的推理轨迹包含初始时没有的信息时,审查最为有用。

blocks.en:
All three review configurations improve mean accuracy and latency over the receiver on math/code. On knowledge tasks, Qwen3.8-Max and GLM-5.3 improve both means, while DeepSeek-V4-Flash improves accuracy but is 0.1 seconds slower on average.
Because longer tasks contribute more to the ratio-of-means latency summary, suite-level improvements do not imply a speedup for every workload or justify a fixed review policy under every latency constraint.
Qwen3.8-Max has the best aggregate accuracy, output volume, and latency in both suites, although these results do not establish a general ranking of sender quality.
blocks.zh:
所有三个审查配置都改进了数学/编码接收器的平均准确性和耐久性。 在知识任务上,Qune3.8-Max和GLM-5.3改进了两种手段,而DeepSeek-V4-Flash则提高了精度,但平均慢了0.1秒.
由于较长的任务更有助于计量延迟比率汇总,套房水平的改进并不意味着每个工作量都加快速度,也不说明有理由根据每个延迟限制制定固定的审查政策。
Qune3.8-Max在两个套房中都具有最好的聚合精度,输出量,和耐久性,尽管这些结果并没有建立发送质量的一般排名.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , training the receiver directly on math/code raises its suite average from 63.94% to 64.2%, but lowers knowledge accuracy from 84.77% to 83.45%, suggesting a small loss in general-knowledge performance. Jointly training the receiver and bridge with latent guidance improves both suites, reaching 66.9% on math/code and 86.44% on knowledge with a single transfer, with further gains from review.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced POND , which decouples frontier-model prefill from small-model
decoding through a learned latent interface. A trainable bridge converts a
frozen sender’s final-layer representations into latent KV entries, from which
a receiver generates the full answer without any textual handoff. Periodic
review extends this to partial responses, refreshing guidance while preserving
the receiver’s generation state. The central contribution is thus an interface
through which a large model participates in generation without decoding text
itself. Establishing its advantage over other collaboration strategies will
require matched-compute text baselines, controlled probes of sender
information, and uncertainty estimates; adaptive review policies and bounded
latent memory are natural next steps.

blocks.en:
We treated the position identifier and release threshold as separate
quantities. The former controlled rotary phase, whereas the latter prevented
a receiver query from reading an unavailable message. For a shared serialized
text, Equation 9 assigned each sender token to the first receiver
token covering its complete source span. Multiple sender tokens could map to
one receiver position; they remained distinct KV entries and did not consume
or shift text-cache positions.

tokenizer-provided offsets before alignment. Sender and receiver offsets were
computed from the same normalized and serialized string, including recorded
chat delimiters and special tokens. We excluded non-text tokens without an
unambiguous receiver counterpart from latent memory rather than assigning
guessed spans. Inputs whose normalization or serialization could not be
reconciled were marked as interface failures and excluded according to the
predefined evaluation rule.

sequence extended the cached token prefix. We used a prefix-stable streaming
tokenization policy and retained token IDs and source spans at every boundary.

unchanged, the implementation recomputed the sender prefix, charged the full
recomputation, and appended only newly available states. If old tokens or
source spans changed, the implementation recorded a tokenization failure and
terminated the request rather than silently altering receiver history. Full
request restarts, where applicable, were recorded separately together with
their work and generated output.

prefix-stable tokenization, available sender state, and custom receiver
kernels. Compressed states are not automatically private or safe to transmit.

outputs. The reported downstream accuracy and efficiency remain specific to
the evaluated models, datasets, configurations, and comparison baselines;
they do not establish a universal advantage over all collaboration methods.
